postings.title: Analytics Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Analytics Engineer:

HTB’s Analytics team is looking for an Analytics Engineer, who will enable various stakeholders to make data-driven decisions. As an Analytics Engineer at Hack The Box, you will bridge the gap between raw data transformation and business decision-making and you will take full end-to-end ownership of from cross-functional data modeling to delivering stakeholder-ready dashboards

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Greece

- Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote). Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

- You will join an ambitious, highly collaborative team of experienced Analytics Engineers working in lockstep with our Data Engineering team to build HTB's next-generation data ecosystem.
- You will act as a primary analytics technical partner to key operational and leadership teams across Finance, Product, Customer Success , Sales, Operations & more

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- SQL
- dbt
- Tableau / Looker
- Git

Experience with Google Cloud Ecosystem BigQuery, Look ML, Looker) & Airflow or similar tools will be considered a plus

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Analytics Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Build and optimise data models (using SQL & dbt) to support business reporting and analysis needs.
- Develop, monitor, maintain, optimise and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure data is accurate
- Implement data quality checks and validation routines to maintain high standards of data integrity.
- Contribute to big scale projects like transition to GCP
- Document data models, data transformations, and business logic for transparency and knowledge sharing.
- Collaborate with other teams and other business stakeholders to define data requirements, business logic, and reporting needs.
- Assist in designing and developing new reports, dashboards, and visualisations based on business needs.
- Provide support and guidance to other team members on data-related matters
- Help build a data-driven culture across HTB

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Analytics Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Proficiency in SQL for complex querying, data transformation, and performance optimization.
- Experience in data modelling and data pipelines
- Experience in Tableau/Looker or at least 1 similar visualization tool
- Experience with Git for version control and collaborative development.
- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, and documentation.
- Strong ability to translate complex data models into clear business insights and partner with cross-functional teams to drive requirements.
- Full professional fluency in written and verbal English for technical documentation and cross-team collaboration.

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰We also have other benefits that will keep you happy:

- Private health care
- Paid parental leave (4 weeks)
- 25 annual leave days
- Free lunch & snacks at the office
- 120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
- Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident
- Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
- Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Analytics Engineer at HTB:

- Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
- Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions.
- Level 3 — Chat with Spiros: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
- Level 4 — Technical Assessment: Put your practical skills to the test through a live coding session with the team.
- Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 5 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻

At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. Whether or not you consider yourself a gamer, we value what makes you unique and want to know more about you. This job post provides just a glimpse of the incredible gamified experience our business and consumer customers enjoy through our platforms. So, if you're ready to embark on a journey of disruption, growth, and adventure, we can't wait to meet you!

ABOUT HACK THE BOX

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Trusted by the Fortune 500, government agencies, and MSSPs, the platform delivers threat-informed learning paths consisting of real-world scenarios in gamified labs and live-fire simulations that build and validate offensive and defensive cyber capabilities. With a loyal community of more than 4 million members and 800+ enterprise customers, Hack The Box empowers teams and intelligent systems alike to strengthen cyber defenses and reduce breach risk effectively.

Rapidly growing its international footprint and reach, Hack The Box is headquartered in the UK, with additional offices in the US, Australia, and Greece.

🚨 News & Resources:

- We’re incredibly proud to share that our headquarters in the UK, along with our entities in Greece and the US, have been certified as a Great Place to Work for 4 consecutive years (2023 - 2026).
- In addition, our Greek entity has been recognized among the Best Workplaces in Greece (4th, 2nd, 3rd, 1st) and Europe (7th, 10th, 73rd) during this period — a testament to our strong culture and commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience!

Take a sneak peek at how it is to be part of HTB. Get more insights about our HTB culture and employee experience by visiting the “about us” section of our site, our career site, and Glassdoor.

At Hack The Box, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We believe that diversity enriches our performance, services, and the communities we serve. As such, we ensure that all job applications are considered solely based on merit, skills, and qualifications. We do not discriminate on grounds of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are dedicated to providing a fair and respectful work environment that reflects our values.

postings.title: Director of Global GSI Alliance
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help redefine cybersecurity upskilling and readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Director of Global GSI Alliance

As the Director of Global GSI Alliance (Individual Contributor role), you will be the primary architect of our strategic partnerships with the world’s most influential System Integrators (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, and DXC). You will drive the global go-to-market (GTM) strategy, steering these partners to build "Powered By" service offerings that leverage our leading training and exercise platform.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Reporting to the Global Head of Partnerships and Alliances, you’ll be part of the Partnerships team. You’ll also be able to connect with multiple internal stakeholders (Sales Team, Solution Engineers, CSMs, Sales Ops, Legal, Finance). Clear communication, high organizational skills, teamwork, and experience building from scratch are the requirements that you’ll need to have, in order to be successful in the role.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Slack, Hubspot, Crossbeam, Jira

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming GSI Lead at Hack The Box:

Strategic GTM & Offer Development

- Joint Solutioning: Build and launch global service offerings based on cyber resilience. Ideally you’ve done this from scratch and understand the bill of materials that is necessary to be created to get this off the ground.
- Platform Integration: Move partners from selling point products to integrating our full platform into their proprietary transformation frameworks.

Executive Relationship Management

- CxO Engagement: Maintain high-level relationships with GSI Global Cybersecurity Leads and CTOs to ensure our roadmap is aligned with their long-term services strategy.
- Influence & Advocacy: Act as the internal "Voice of the GSI," ensuring our Product and Engineering teams are building features that make our platform ready for GSI consumption.

Sales & Pipeline Acceleration

- Pipeline Generation: Drive partner sourced and partner influenced revenue through joint account planning and co-selling in the Enterprise and Public Sector segments.
- Forecasting: Provide accurate quarterly forecasts for the global GSI business, managing complex multi-year sell-to and sell-through contracts.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Director of Global GSI Alliance at Hack The Box:

- 7-10+ Years in Partnerships: Proven track record of successfully managing portfolios with Tier 1 GSIs.
- KPIs: services launched, partner sourced ARR, attach rate
- Cybersecurity Fluency: Plus but not required
- Experience building and launching global service offerings.
- Demonstrate leadership that promotes and exemplifies the highest levels of teamwork, personal accountability, and mutual support to the Partner.
- Must be willing to travel.

💰The gems you’ll be enjoying:

- Comp: 217,000-260,000 OTE, 70/30 split
- Medical, Dental & Vision (employee coverage 100% paid for by Hack The Box)
- 401K w/ employer match
- Employer-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
- Supplemental Life Insurance
- Short-term and Long-term Disability
- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
- Paid parental leave
- 25 annual leave days
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment

You will drive the global go-to-market (GTM) strategy, steering these partners to build "Powered By" service offerings that leverage our leading training and exercise platform.

- Platform Integration: Move partners from selling point products to integrating our full platform into their proprietary transformation frameworks.

Executive Relationship Management

- CxO Engagement: Maintain high-level relationships with GSI Global Cybersecurity Leads and CTOs to ensure our roadmap is aligned with their long-term services strategy.

Sales & Pipeline Acceleration

- Pipeline Generation: Drive partner sourced and partner influenced revenue through joint account planning and co-selling in the Enterprise and Public Sector segments.
- Forecasting: Provide accurate quarterly forecasts for the global GSI business, managing complex multi-year sell-to and sell-through contracts.

- 7-10+ Years in Partnerships: Proven track record of successfully managing portfolios with Tier 1 GSIs.
- KPIs: services launched, partner sourced ARR, attach rate
- Cybersecurity Fluency: Plus but not required
- Experience building and launching global service offerings.
- Demonstrate leadership that promotes and exemplifies the highest levels of teamwork, personal accountability, and mutual support to the Partner.
- Must be willing to travel.

- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

- Comp: 217,000-260,000 OTE, 70/30 split
- Medical, Dental & Vision (employee coverage 100% paid for by Hack The Box)
- 401K w/ employer match
- Employer-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
- Supplemental Life Insurance

- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
- Paid parental leave
- 25 annual leave days
- Home Office Allowance

postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Finance Manager

Your mission will be to be responsible for financial modeling, investor reporting, budgeting and forecasting, analyzing financial data, conducting variance analysis, and preparing management reports. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to align financial planning with business objectives and provide recommendations to optimize financial performance.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- US (East Coast - Mandatory)
- Fully Remote

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will work closely with various stakeholders, including the finance team (accounting), executive management, and investors.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Oracle Netsuite ERP
- Google Sheets (Expertise is a plus) and MS Excel
- Looker for data visualization
- Other financial systems (or similar) and data tools

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming the Finance Manager at Hack The Box:

- Lead the financial planning and budgeting process, aligning financial goals with business objectives
- Develop and maintain financial models to support decision-making and provide insightful analysis
- Support fundraising, strategic partnership conversations and external investor processes including data room prep, reporting and diligence
- Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement
- Generate precise and up-to-date financial statements, encompassing monthly, quarterly, and yearly performance evaluations, and prepare materials for board presentations
- Collaborate with business partners to optimize financial performance and drive cost efficiency
- Provide financial guidance and support to executive management
- Participate in strategic planning and forecasting activities
- Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in financial planning and analysis
- Ensure compliance with financial policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Finance Manager at Hack The Box:

- Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or equivalent quantitative field
- 3+ years or equivalent tenure from related positions in investment banking, venture capital, private equity, FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or data analytics
- Willingness to roll up your sleeves, handle large amounts of data, and build complex financial models. Expertise in Google Sheets is a plus
- Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis in a high-growth environment
- Background with financial systems (e.g., NetSuite, Excel, or similar) and data tools
- Strong understanding of GAAP/IFRS and non-GAAP/IFRS financial metrics (especially SaaS metrics)

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰We also have other benefits that will keep you happy:

- Compensation: USD 140,000-170,000 Gross Annual
- Medical, Dental & Vision (employee coverage 100% paid for by Hack The Box)
- 401K w/ employer match
- Employer-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
- Supplemental Life Insurance
- Short-term and Long-term Disability
- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
- Paid paternity & maternity leave
- 25 annual leave days
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Finance Manager at HTB:

- Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
- Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions.
- Level 3 — Chat with Jeff: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
- Level 4 — Practical Task and Panel Presentation: A real-world scenario that lets you show how you’d approach product management with your unique perspective. You’ll present your work to a panel of the team — no trick questions, no gotchas, just a chance to show us how you think and tell a story.
- Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership (CPO) to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

✨The core mission of the Growth Marketing Specialist

Drive net-new user acquisition for Hack The Box’s B2C platform by executing and optimizing scalable growth initiatives across creators, partnerships, paid/social campaigns, SEO, and other acquisition channels. Own the day-to-day execution, experimentation, and performance tracking needed to identify repeatable growth opportunities and continuously increase the volume and quality of new users.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Full-time role
- Athens, Greece Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all cities in Greece. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.
- England, United Kingdom (Fully remote)

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will work closely with the consumer marketing leadership team, owning the operational execution of net-new user acquisition while partnering with colleagues focused on engagement, activation, adoption, and lifecycle marketing. You will also collaborate with external creators, affiliates, partners, and performance agencies, translating growth objectives into campaigns and measurable initiatives.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Core Tools: Google Analytics, SEO tools, affiliate/creator management tools, and reporting/dashboard tools.
- AI & Productivity: Generative AI tools for campaign ideation, copywriting, research, analysis, and improving day-to-day marketing efficiency

📚 Interesting resources you should check:

- Humans of HTB #11: Dimitris’s journey into product marketing
- Case studies

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming a Growth Marketing Specialist at Hack The Box:

- Own B2C acquisition campaigns across relevant channels, including paid/social media, creators, partnerships, SEO, and emerging growth opportunities.
- Manage the creator and influencer pipeline end-to-end, including outreach, campaign briefs, negotiations, execution, budgets, and performance tracking.
- Develop and manage partnership and affiliate initiatives, including onboarding, communication, campaign coordination, and ongoing performance monitoring.
- Plan, launch, and evaluate growth experiments by developing hypotheses, defining KPIs, testing campaigns, and identifying scalable acquisition opportunities.
- Collaborate with external performance agencies where relevant, providing direction on campaigns and creative requirements while monitoring execution and ROI.
- Create and optimize growth content and campaign messaging that resonates with technical, cybersecurity-curious, and developer audiences.
- Track and communicate acquisition performance, using metrics such as signups, conversion rates, CAC, channel ROI, attribution, impressions, and campaign performance to inform business decisions.

- 2+ years of experience in B2C growth, digital, performance, or consumer marketing, with a demonstrated track record of driving user acquisition.
- Hands-on experience executing and testing multi-channel acquisition campaigns, rather than solely owning high-level marketing strategy.
- Strong understanding of growth metrics and performance marketing, including CAC, conversion rates, ROI, attribution, and campaign KPIs.
- Strong copywriting and campaign development skills, with the ability to create engaging messaging and adapt it to technical or cybersecurity-oriented audiences.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives, make decisions based on data and available resources, and use AI/tools to improve marketing efficiency.
- Technical curiosity and comfort with technology, with an understanding of technical concepts and an interest in cybersecurity, SaaS, developer tools, or similar technical products. Curiosity and some experience in using AI solutions to improve efficiency and ways of working.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with diverse audiences.

Strong nice-to-have:

- Experience working with creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, or communities, ideally managing relationships and campaigns directly.
- Has previous experience working in the cybersecurity field
- Has previous experience managing paid advertising

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

- Private health care
- Paid paternity leave (extended support)
- Parenthood & Family Building Benefits
- 25 annual leave days + Summer Fridays (4-6)
- Free lunch & snacks at the office
- 120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
- Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident
- Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
- Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing

Drive net-new user acquisition for Hack The Box’s B2C platform by executing and optimizing scalable growth initiatives across creators, partnerships, paid/social campaigns, SEO, and other acquisition channels. Own the day-to-day execution, experimentation, and performance tracking needed to identify repeatable growth opportunities and continuously increase the volume and quality of new users.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Full-time role
- Athens, Greece Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all cities in Greece. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will work closely with the consumer marketing leadership team, owning the operational execution of net-new user acquisition while partnering with colleagues focused on engagement, activation, adoption, and lifecycle marketing. - AI & Productivity: Generative AI tools for campaign ideation, copywriting, research, analysis, and improving day-to-day marketing efficiency

📚 Interesting resources you should check:

- Humans of HTB #11: Dimitris’s journey into product marketing
- Case studies

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming a Growth Marketing Specialist at Hack The Box:

- Own B2C acquisition campaigns across relevant channels, including paid/social media, creators, partnerships, SEO, and emerging growth opportunities.
- Manage the creator and influencer pipeline end-to-end, including outreach, campaign briefs, negotiations, execution, budgets, and performance tracking.
- Develop and manage partnership and affiliate initiatives, including onboarding, communication, campaign coordination, and ongoing performance monitoring.
- Plan, launch, and evaluate growth experiments by developing hypotheses, defining KPIs, testing campaigns, and identifying scalable acquisition opportunities.
- Collaborate with external performance agencies where relevant, providing direction on campaigns and creative requirements while monitoring execution and ROI.
- Create and optimize growth content and campaign messaging that resonates with technical, cybersecurity-curious, and developer audiences.
- Track and communicate acquisition performance, using metrics such as signups, conversion rates, CAC, channel ROI, attribution, impressions, and campaign performance to inform business decisions.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Growth Marketing Specialist at Hack The Box:

- 2+ years of experience in B2C growth, digital, performance, or consumer marketing, with a demonstrated track record of driving user acquisition.
- Hands-on experience executing and testing multi-channel acquisition campaigns, rather than solely owning high-level marketing strategy.
- Strong understanding of growth metrics and performance marketing, including CAC, conversion rates, ROI, attribution, and campaign KPIs.
- Strong copywriting and campaign development skills, with the ability to create engaging messaging and adapt it to technical or cybersecurity-oriented audiences.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives, make decisions based on data and available resources, and use AI/tools to improve marketing efficiency.
- Technical curiosity and comfort with technology, with an understanding of technical concepts and an interest in cybersecurity, SaaS, developer tools, or similar technical products. Curiosity and some experience in using AI solutions to improve efficiency and ways of working.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with diverse audiences.

- Experience working with creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, or communities, ideally managing relationships and campaigns directly.
- Has previous experience working in the cybersecurity field
- Has previous experience managing paid advertising

- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰We also have other benefits that will keep you happy:

- Private health care
- Paid paternity leave (extended support)
- Parenthood & Family Building Benefits
- 25 annual leave days + Summer Fridays (4-6)
- Free lunch & snacks at the office
- 120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
- Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident
- Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
- Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing

postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Head of CS, AMEA & APAC

As the Head of CS, EMEA and APAC, your mission is to lead and empower a team of Customer Success Associates and Managers in the EMEA and APAC regions, fostering excellence in customer experiences that drive retention, adoption, expansion, and growth. You aim to take full ownership of key CS operating model initiatives, collaborate cross-functionally, and leverage data to continuously improve client experiences, while building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders. Your active participation in the Customer Success leadership team contributes to the vision, strategy, planning, and execution, ensuring strategic growth and the success of your customers.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Full-time employment
- 2 options for direct employment: UK (fully remote) or Athens, Greece (hybrid OR fully remote if located outside Athens)
- We're open to exploring any country within the European time zone

✈️ Relocation

We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your relocation to Athens, Greece. In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction as part of the relocation (if you comply with the gov criteria). We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

As the Head of CS, you will be working closely with a diverse range of stakeholders, including your team of Customer Success Associates and Managers, as well as leaders in Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps, Finance, and Marketing. You are required to partner with EMEA and APAC Sales Leadership on managing those regions, on brainstorming and executing strategic growth initiatives, and building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming the Head of CS at Hack The Box:

- Own and drive the regional Gross Retention Rate (GRR) and Net Retention Rate (NRR) metrics
- Recruit, manage & coach a team of Customer Success Associates and Customer Success Managers in the EMEA and APAC regions, and empower them to deliver excellent customer experiences that drive retention & adoption, as well as expansion & growth.
- Have tremendous direct impact on growing our EMEA and APAC CS teams, building our culture, evolving the way we make our customers successful, and helping HTB grow.
- Active participation in the Customer Success leadership team, contributing vision & strategy, planning and execution.

- As a customer-facing leader, build trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Head of CS at Hack The Box:

- You’ll have 5+ of experience leading enterprise customer success teams in a B2B SaaS company
- You have a mentoring and growth mindset, coaching your CS team to lead value-based client conversations, empowering them to succeed, and providing feedback for their development.
- You’ll have an entrepreneurial spirit with a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, and identify internal process gaps that you can help evolve and fix as HTB scales.
- Strong track record of partnering with Sales, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional leaders and stakeholders to deliver results.
- You’re adept at being the senior voice in meaningful, data-informed Quarterly Business Review sessions with our clients.
- You’re technically savvy, with experience using the tech-stack and tool-kit of a modern SaaS Customer Success leader. You’re also keen to develop a strong knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, the HTB platform and solutions.

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰We also have other benefits that will keep you happy (Athens, Greece):

- Private health care
- Paid parental leave (4 weeks)
- 25 annual leave days
- Free lunch & snacks at the office
- 120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
- Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident
- Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
- Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing

[Important Note: Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract)]

- Level 3 — Chat with Petros: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
- Level 4 — Complete a job-specific challenge and have a meaningful conversation with the wider team.
- Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.

postings.title: Partner Development Manager, Federal
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest to join Hack The Box?

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨ The core mission of the Partner Development Manager (Federal)

At Hack The Box (HTB), we are the world’s leading platform for cybersecurity upskilling, certification, and talent assessment. We are redefining how Defense Departments and Public Sector entities develop their cyber workforce. By providing a gamified, hands-on environment, we help missions close the skills gap, defend against state-sponsored threats, and build elite, sovereign cyber capabilities.

The Partner Development Manager, Federal will be the architect of our public sector ecosystem across North America. You will be responsible for managing strategic resellers, boutique defense contractors, and large System Integrators who hold the keys to the region's most critical infrastructure. You will work closely with Sales and Marketing to ensure our partners are cleared, enabled, and positioned to win large-scale government tenders.

🏢 Location & Work Mode

- US
- Fully Remote

🚀 The adventures that await you:

1. Relationship Management

- Federal Resellers & GSIs: This is your core focus. You will manage existing specialized Federal resellers and SIs. You will ensure HTB is baked into their Cyber Practice and long-term government contracts.
- Complementary Tech Alliances: Work with existing strategic technology partners that have a strong Federal footprint. You will explore joint GTM motions to provide a holistic Cyber Readiness solution for government agencies.

2. Business Development & Growth

- Pipeline & Frameworks: Identify and qualify new public sector opportunities. You will help partners navigate frameworks and government procurement vehicles to ensure HTB is the preferred upskilling provider.
- Co-Selling & Tender Support: Support partner sales cycles by navigating complex government procurement processes. You will provide the "HTB expertise" during RFI/RFP stages, ensuring our value proposition is clearly articulated to technical and non-technical government stakeholders.
- Mission-Aligned GTM: Collaborate with internal teams to build Federal GTM strategies, focusing on workforce transformation within SLED, military, and intelligence communities.

3. Communication & Operations

- QBRs & Executive Alignment: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews with key Federal partners to track performance, share updates on the HTB roadmap and realign on strategic mission goals.
- Enablement: Facilitate the training of partner sales and technical teams. Ensure they can articulate the shift from "theoretical training" to "hands-on cyber performance" that HTB provides.

postings.title: Senior Data Engineer
postings.description:
Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳
Let's redefine cyber security expertise standards and connect business - community through highly engaging hacking experiences. (Find out more insights about Hack The Box culture in our career site).

✨The core mission of the Senior Data Engineer:

You will own and evolve our data pipelines on GCP — building new ones, hardening existing ones, improving data quality, and making clean, trustworthy data available across the organisation. You'll work end-to-end on streaming and batch pipelines, from CDC and event ingestion through transformation, serving, and the feature layer that powers our ML and AI products.

Your day-to-day will include designing ELT/ETL processes on BigQuery and ClickHouse, building real-time pipelines on Pub/Sub and Kafka with Dataflow (and where it fits, Flink/Spark), orchestrating workflows with Airflow, and ensuring data is properly cleaned, modelled, and served for analytics, ML training, and online inference. You'll partner with ML engineers on feature pipelines, monitoring data drift, and keeping models well-fed and retrained as needed. You'll consume and build REST APIs, integrate with third-party SaaS sources, and treat infrastructure as code.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- US
- Fully Remote

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the Data, Analytics & AI team, collaborating closely with Infrastructure, Software Engineering, Product, and ML/AI engineers. We're in the middle of a GCP-native modernisation — migrating away from Snowflake toward BigQuery, Bigtable, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow — so we're looking for someone who's opinionated about clean architecture, allergic to over-engineering, and comfortable owning systems end-to-end. If retiring a legacy warehouse and standing up its replacement sounds like a good time, you'll fit right in.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Cloud & warehouse: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Cloud Storage
- Streaming & messaging: Pub/Sub, Kafka
- Processing: Dataflow (Apache Beam), with Flink/Spark where appropriate
- Orchestration: Airflow (Cloud Composer)
- Analytical store: ClickHouse
- Languages: Python, SQL
- Modelling & quality: dbt, data quality gates
- Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions / equivalent
- Legacy (being retired): Snowflake

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Data Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Design and build batch and streaming pipelines on Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Kafka feeding BigQuery, Bigtable, and ClickHouse
- Help drive the migration off Snowflake onto our GCP-native stack — and retire shadow pipelines along the way
- Own the orchestration layer in Airflow, including SLAs, retries, and data quality gates
- Model data for analytics and for ML — including feature pipelines that serve both training and low-latency online inference
- Partner with ML engineers on feature stores, drift monitoring, and retraining workflows
- Capture requirements from stakeholders and translate them into pragmatic, well-scoped data products
- Continuously improve data quality, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency
- Identify new data sources worth acquiring and integrate them cleanly

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of the Senior Data Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Strong data modelling and warehouse architecture skills (dimensional modelling, event-driven, lakehouse patterns)
- Hands-on experience with GCP data services — BigQuery is a must; Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Bigtable, Cloud Composer are strong pluses
- Production experience with streaming pipelines on Dataflow/Beam, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming, ingesting from Kafka and/or Pub/Sub
- Solid SQL and strong Python — you write production-quality code, not just notebooks
- Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar OLAP engine in production
- Workflow orchestration experience with Airflow (or Prefect/Dagster)
- Comfortable with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks
- Experience migrating off legacy warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse) onto cloud-native stacks is a plus
- Working knowledge of ML in production — feature engineering, feature stores, model deployment, drift monitoring, retraining
- Docker & Kubernetes experience
- CI/CD mindset, infrastructure-as-code sensibility, and a bias for simple, observable systems
- Bonus: CDC tooling (Datastream, Debezium), Vertex AI / Feature Store

What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows

postings.description:

✨The core mission of the Senior Data Engineer:

You will own and evolve our data pipelines on GCP — building new ones, hardening existing ones, improving data quality, and making clean, trustworthy data available across the organisation. You'll work end-to-end on streaming and batch pipelines, from CDC and event ingestion through transformation, serving, and the feature layer that powers our ML and AI products.

Your day-to-day will include designing ELT/ETL processes on BigQuery and ClickHouse, building real-time pipelines on Pub/Sub and Kafka with Dataflow (and where it fits, Flink/Spark), orchestrating workflows with Airflow, and ensuring data is properly cleaned, modelled, and served for analytics, ML training, and online inference. You'll partner with ML engineers on feature pipelines, monitoring data drift, and keeping models well-fed and retrained as needed. You'll consume and build REST APIs, integrate with third-party SaaS sources, and treat infrastructure as code.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- US
- Fully Remote

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the Data, Analytics & AI team, collaborating closely with Infrastructure, Software Engineering, Product, and ML/AI engineers. We're in the middle of a GCP-native modernisation — migrating away from Snowflake toward BigQuery, Bigtable, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow — so we're looking for someone who's opinionated about clean architecture, allergic to over-engineering, and comfortable owning systems end-to-end. If retiring a legacy warehouse and standing up its replacement sounds like a good time, you'll fit right in.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Cloud & warehouse: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Cloud Storage
- Streaming & messaging: Pub/Sub, Kafka
- Processing: Dataflow (Apache Beam), with Flink/Spark where appropriate
- Orchestration: Airflow (Cloud Composer)
- Analytical store: ClickHouse
- Languages: Python, SQL
- Modelling & quality: dbt, data quality gates
- Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions / equivalent
- Legacy (being retired): Snowflake

- Model data for analytics and for ML — including feature pipelines that serve both training and low-latency online inference
- Partner with ML engineers on feature stores, drift monitoring, and retraining workflows

- Identify new data sources worth acquiring and integrate them cleanly

- Strong data modelling and warehouse architecture skills (dimensional modelling, event-driven, lakehouse patterns)
- Hands-on experience with GCP data services — BigQuery is a must; Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Bigtable, Cloud Composer are strong pluses
- Production experience with streaming pipelines on Dataflow/Beam, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming, ingesting from Kafka and/or Pub/Sub
- Solid SQL and strong Python — you write production-quality code, not just notebooks
- Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar OLAP engine in production
- Workflow orchestration experience with Airflow (or Prefect/Dagster)
- Comfortable with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks
- Experience migrating off legacy warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse) onto cloud-native stacks is a plus
- Working knowledge of ML in production — feature engineering, feature stores, model deployment, drift monitoring, retraining
- Docker & Kubernetes experience
- CI/CD mindset, infrastructure-as-code sensibility, and a bias for simple, observable systems
- Bonus: CDC tooling (Datastream, Debezium), Vertex AI / Feature Store

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows

- Supplemental Life Insurance
- Short-term and Long-term Disability
- Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

- 25 annual leave days

- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉

postings.description:
Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳
Let's redefine cyber security expertise standards and connect business - community through highly engaging hacking experiences. (Find out more insights about Hack The Box culture in our career site).

✨The core mission of the Senior Data Engineer:

You will own and evolve our data pipelines on GCP — building new ones, hardening existing ones, improving data quality, and making clean, trustworthy data available across the organisation. You'll work end-to-end on streaming and batch pipelines, from CDC and event ingestion through transformation, serving, and the feature layer that powers our ML and AI products.

Your day-to-day will include designing ELT/ETL processes on BigQuery and ClickHouse, building real-time pipelines on Pub/Sub and Kafka with Dataflow (and where it fits, Flink/Spark), orchestrating workflows with Airflow, and ensuring data is properly cleaned, modelled, and served for analytics, ML training, and online inference. You'll partner with ML engineers on feature pipelines, monitoring data drift, and keeping models well-fed and retrained as needed. You'll consume and build REST APIs, integrate with third-party SaaS sources, and treat infrastructure as code.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the Data, Analytics & AI team, collaborating closely with Infrastructure, Software Engineering, Product, and ML/AI engineers. We're in the middle of a GCP-native modernisation — migrating away from Snowflake toward BigQuery, Bigtable, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow — so we're looking for someone who's opinionated about clean architecture, allergic to over-engineering, and comfortable owning systems end-to-end. If retiring a legacy warehouse and standing up its replacement sounds like a good time, you'll fit right in.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Cloud & warehouse: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Cloud Storage
- Streaming & messaging: Pub/Sub, Kafka
- Processing: Dataflow (Apache Beam), with Flink/Spark where appropriate
- Orchestration: Airflow (Cloud Composer)
- Analytical store: ClickHouse
- Languages: Python, SQL
- Modelling & quality: dbt, data quality gates
- Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions / equivalent
- Legacy (being retired): Snowflake

- Design and build batch and streaming pipelines on Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Kafka feeding BigQuery, Bigtable, and ClickHouse
- Help drive the migration off Snowflake onto our GCP-native stack — and retire shadow pipelines along the way
- Own the orchestration layer in Airflow, including SLAs, retries, and data quality gates
- Model data for analytics and for ML — including feature pipelines that serve both training and low-latency online inference
- Partner with ML engineers on feature stores, drift monitoring, and retraining workflows
- Capture requirements from stakeholders and translate them into pragmatic, well-scoped data products
- Continuously improve data quality, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency
- Identify new data sources worth acquiring and integrate them cleanly

- Strong data modelling and warehouse architecture skills (dimensional modelling, event-driven, lakehouse patterns)

- Production experience with streaming pipelines on Dataflow/Beam, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming, ingesting from Kafka and/or Pub/Sub
- Solid SQL and strong Python — you write production-quality code, not just notebooks
- Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar OLAP engine in production
- Workflow orchestration experience with Airflow (or Prefect/Dagster)
- Comfortable with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks
- Experience migrating off legacy warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse) onto cloud-native stacks is a plus
- Working knowledge of ML in production — feature engineering, feature stores, model deployment, drift monitoring, retraining
- Docker & Kubernetes experience
- CI/CD mindset, infrastructure-as-code sensibility, and a bias for simple, observable systems
- Bonus: CDC tooling (Datastream, Debezium), Vertex AI / Feature Store

Let's redefine cyber security expertise standards and connect business - community through highly engaging hacking experiences. (Find out more insights about Hack The Box culture in our career site).

As a Senior Defensive Content Engineer, you will play a pivotal, hands-on technical role within an elite team of content engineers. Your mission: architect, build, and rigorously validate complex, live-fire cyber ranges and threat hunting labs that directly elevate the defensive capabilities of top-tier enterprise organizations worldwide.

- Mindset: Self-motivated, structured, and genuinely passionate about cybersecurity education and gamified learning.

✨The core mission of the Senior Elixir Engineer:

Join our fast-growing team building the platform that trains the world's cyber workforce. As a Senior Elixir Engineer, you'll own backend and full-stack feature delivery on Phoenix and LiveView — designing resilient OTP systems, clean APIs, and real-time user experiences that scale to millions of users.

Our culture prizes autonomy, technical craft, and the drive to ship secure software that outsmarts attackers.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence, you will be part of a 7 people team. You'll collaborate with product, design, and security researchers to turn complex detection and response workflows into intuitive, intelligence-driven user experiences—while mentoring engineers and shaping our technical roadmap.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Elixir / Erlang / OTP
- Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Phoenix PubSub
- Ecto & PostgreSQL
- Oban (background jobs)
- Tailwind CSS, LiveView JS hooks
- Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry
- Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Design and build production Phoenix applications — REST APIs, LiveView UIs, and real-time features on PubSub and Channels.
- Model and evolve data with Ecto and PostgreSQL, writing performant queries and safe, zero-downtime migrations.
- Build fault-tolerant systems with OTP: supervision trees, GenServers, and distributed BEAM patterns where they earn their keep.
- Own background processing and scheduled workloads with Oban, with proper observability via Telemetry and metrics.
- Ship secure-by-default code: authentication/authorization patterns, least-privilege data access, and input hardening — this is a security company.
- Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes/GCP, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and release quality.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership through code reviews, design sessions, and coding standards.
- Document decisions and communicate clearly in a remote-first environment, contributing to a culture of thoughtful async collaboration.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 5+ years of professional backend or full-stack development, with 3+ years shipping production Elixir/Phoenix.
- Strong grasp of OTP and the BEAM — processes, supervision, GenServer/GenStage, and when not to reach for them.
- Hands-on experience building interactive UIs with Phoenix LiveView (components, streams, JS hooks).
- Deep Ecto and PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, query optimization, indexing, migrations.
- Experience with background job systems (Oban preferred) and event-driven architectures.
- Solid testing discipline with ExUnit; comfortable with property-based and integration testing.
- Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD best practices.
- Security-minded engineering: OWASP fundamentals, auth patterns, secure handling of user data.
- Excellent written & verbal communication, especially in remote/async environments, with a bias toward documenting architecture and decisions.

- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.

- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

- 25 annual leave days

- Flexibility in working hours

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Elixir Engineer:

Join our fast-growing team building the platform that trains the world's cyber workforce. As a Senior Elixir Engineer, you'll own backend and full-stack feature delivery on Phoenix and LiveView — designing resilient OTP systems, clean APIs, and real-time user experiences that scale to millions of users.

Our culture prizes autonomy, technical craft, and the drive to ship secure software that outsmarts attackers.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Reporting to the VP of Artificial Intelligence, you will be part of a 7 people team. You'll collaborate with product, design, and security researchers to turn complex detection and response workflows into intuitive, intelligence-driven user experiences—while mentoring engineers and shaping our technical roadmap.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Elixir / Erlang / OTP
- Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Phoenix PubSub
- Ecto & PostgreSQL
- Oban (background jobs)
- Tailwind CSS, LiveView JS hooks
- Telemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry
- Docker, Kubernetes, GCP

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Design and build production Phoenix applications — REST APIs, LiveView UIs, and real-time features on PubSub and Channels.
- Model and evolve data with Ecto and PostgreSQL, writing performant queries and safe, zero-downtime migrations.
- Build fault-tolerant systems with OTP: supervision trees, GenServers, and distributed BEAM patterns where they earn their keep.
- Own background processing and scheduled workloads with Oban, with proper observability via Telemetry and metrics.
- Ship secure-by-default code: authentication/authorization patterns, least-privilege data access, and input hardening — this is a security company.
- Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes/GCP, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and release quality.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership through code reviews, design sessions, and coding standards.
- Document decisions and communicate clearly in a remote-first environment, contributing to a culture of thoughtful async collaboration.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Elixir Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 5+ years of professional backend or full-stack development, with 3+ years shipping production Elixir/Phoenix.
- Strong grasp of OTP and the BEAM — processes, supervision, GenServer/GenStage, and when not to reach for them.
- Hands-on experience building interactive UIs with Phoenix LiveView (components, streams, JS hooks).
- Deep Ecto and PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, query optimization, indexing, migrations.
- Experience with background job systems (Oban preferred) and event-driven architectures.
- Solid testing discipline with ExUnit; comfortable with property-based and integration testing.
- Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD best practices.
- Security-minded engineering: OWASP fundamentals, auth patterns, secure handling of user data.
- Excellent written & verbal communication, especially in remote/async environments, with a bias toward documenting architecture and decisions.

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Elixir Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior Elixir Engineer:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻

At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. Whether or not you consider yourself a gamer, we value what makes you unique and want to know more about you. This job post provides just a glimpse of the incredible gamified experience our business and consumer customers enjoy through our platforms. So, if you're ready to embark on a journey of growth and adventure, we can't wait to meet you!

ABOUT HTB:

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Trusted by the Fortune 500, government agencies, and MSSPs, the platform delivers threat-informed learning paths consisting of real-world scenarios in gamified labs and live-fire simulations that build and validate offensive and defensive cyber capabilities. With a loyal community of more than 4 million members and 800+ enterprise customers, Hack The Box empowers teams and intelligent systems alike to strengthen cyber defenses and reduce breach risk effectively.

Rapidly growing its international footprint and reach, Hack The Box is headquartered in the UK, with additional offices in the US, Australia, and Greece.

🚨 News & Resources:

- We’re incredibly proud to share that our headquarters in the UK, along with our entities in Greece and the US, have been certified as a Great Place to Work for 4 consecutive years (2023 - 2026).
- In addition, our Greek entity has been recognized among the Best Workplaces in Greece (4th, 2nd, 3rd, 1st) and Europe (7th, 10th, 73rd) during this period — a testament to our strong culture and commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience!

Take a sneak peek at how it is to be part of HTB. Get more insights about our HTB culture and employee experience by visiting the “about us” section of our site, our career site, and Glassdoor.

At Hack The Box, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We believe that diversity enriches our performance, services, and the communities we serve. As such, we ensure that all job applications are considered solely based on merit, skills, and qualifications. We do not discriminate on grounds of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We are dedicated to providing a fair and respectful work environment that reflects our values.

postings.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Infrastructure engineer:

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build, maintain and evolve the compute, storage and container platforms that power Hack The Box across data centers in the US, EU, Singapore and Australia. You'll work at the intersection of bare-metal infrastructure, virtualization and cloud-native tooling — and play a key role in one of HTB's most impactful infrastructure initiatives: the migration away from VMware toward an open-source virtualization and cloud platform.

Core mission: Operate and improve HTB's virtualization and storage stack (VMware vSphere, Ceph, Kubernetes) while helping the team evaluate, plan and execute a migration to an open-source alternative

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

VMware vSphere, VMware NSX, Kubernetes, Ceph (NVMEoF / RBD),Linux (Debian), Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus / Grafana, Golang

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Operate and maintain VMware vSphere clusters and NSX-based virtual networking across multiple data center sites
- Administer and tune Ceph storage clusters, including NVMEoF-backed pools and RBD volumes
- Deploy, upgrade and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters running on bare-metal and virtualized infrastructure
- Contribute to the evaluation and proof-of-concept work for migrating from VMware to an open-source platform.
- Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Ansible playbooks, Terraform modules) for repeatable, auditable deployments
- Monitor infrastructure health and performance using Prometheus, Grafana and alerting pipelines; respond to incidents
- Collaborate with the network engineering team on data center connectivity, VLAN/VRF provisioning and storage-network performance
- Support hardware lifecycle operations: racking, provisioning, firmware updates and decommissioning across regions
- Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and post-incident reviews
- Participate in on-call rotation for infrastructure-related incidents

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 3–5 years of professional experience in infrastructure, systems or platform engineering
- Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere administration (cluster management, resource pools, vMotion, HA/DRS)
- Working knowledge of VMware NSX or similar software-defined networking
- Experience administering Ceph storage (or comparable distributed storage systems)
- Solid Kubernetes operations experience (deployment, upgrades, troubleshooting, cluster lifecycle)
- Strong Linux systems administration skills (Debian)
- Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Terraform)
- Comfortable working with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana)
- Good written communication skills for documentation and remote-first collaboration
- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus

Bonus Points:

- Hands-on experience with OpenStack, CloudStack or similar
- Experience with Ceph NVMEoF transport or RDMA-based storage networking
- Understanding of Golang for writing internal automation or tooling
- Familiarity with BGP, EVPN-VXLAN or data center networking concepts
- Experience with bare-metal provisioning tools (Tinkerbell)
- Previous work in a multi-region data center environment

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Infrastructure Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.
