postings.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Infrastructure engineer:

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build, maintain and evolve the compute, storage and container platforms that power Hack The Box across data centers in the US, EU, Singapore and Australia. You'll work at the intersection of bare-metal infrastructure, virtualization and cloud-native tooling — and play a key role in one of HTB's most impactful infrastructure initiatives: the migration away from VMware toward an open-source virtualization and cloud platform.

Core mission: Operate and improve HTB's virtualization and storage stack (VMware vSphere, Ceph, Kubernetes) while helping the team evaluate, plan and execute a migration to an open-source alternative

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

VMware vSphere, VMware NSX, Kubernetes, Ceph (NVMEoF / RBD),Linux (Debian), Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus / Grafana, Golang

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Operate and maintain VMware vSphere clusters and NSX-based virtual networking across multiple data center sites
- Administer and tune Ceph storage clusters, including NVMEoF-backed pools and RBD volumes
- Deploy, upgrade and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters running on bare-metal and virtualized infrastructure
- Contribute to the evaluation and proof-of-concept work for migrating from VMware to an open-source platform.
- Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Ansible playbooks, Terraform modules) for repeatable, auditable deployments
- Monitor infrastructure health and performance using Prometheus, Grafana and alerting pipelines; respond to incidents
- Collaborate with the network engineering team on data center connectivity, VLAN/VRF provisioning and storage-network performance
- Support hardware lifecycle operations: racking, provisioning, firmware updates and decommissioning across regions
- Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and post-incident reviews
- Participate in on-call rotation for infrastructure-related incidents

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 3–5 years of professional experience in infrastructure, systems or platform engineering
- Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere administration (cluster management, resource pools, vMotion, HA/DRS)
- Working knowledge of VMware NSX or similar software-defined networking
- Experience administering Ceph storage (or comparable distributed storage systems)
- Solid Kubernetes operations experience (deployment, upgrades, troubleshooting, cluster lifecycle)
- Strong Linux systems administration skills (Debian)
- Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Terraform)
- Comfortable working with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana)
- Good written communication skills for documentation and remote-first collaboration
- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus

Bonus Points:

- Hands-on experience with OpenStack, CloudStack or similar
- Experience with Ceph NVMEoF transport or RDMA-based storage networking
- Understanding of Golang for writing internal automation or tooling
- Familiarity with BGP, EVPN-VXLAN or data center networking concepts
- Experience with bare-metal provisioning tools (Tinkerbell)
- Previous work in a multi-region data center environment

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Infrastructure Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior Infrastructure Engineer:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. - We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

Identity & Access: Okta (SSO, SCIM, Lifecycle Management, Okta Workflows), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Admin Console)

Endpoint & Device Management: Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS)

AI / LLM Gateway: LiteLLM or Portkey (centralised LLM routing, cost controls, audit logging), API key management

Collaboration & Productivity: Slack, Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Notion, GitHub (org-level administration)

- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus — at HTB, this isn't an afterthought, it's the business

- Experience deploying and operating a centralised LLM/AI gateway (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) with cost and access controls

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior IT Platform engineer:

As an Internal Platform Engineer, you will own and evolve the internal tooling and enterprise platforms that keep a 300+ person, globally distributed company running securely and productively. This is not a helpdesk role — you'll be the engineering backbone behind identity & access management, corporate email and collaboration, device management, SaaS orchestration and our centralised AI/LLM gateway. You'll ensure that every team at HTB has the right tools, properly integrated, secured and automated.

Engineer, integrate and operate HTB's internal platform stack — from identity (Okta) and email (Google Workspace) through endpoint management (Jamf) to our centralised LLM gateway — so that the company scales securely without friction.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

Identity & Access: Okta (SSO, SCIM, Lifecycle Management, Okta Workflows), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Admin Console)

Endpoint & Device Management: Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS)

AI / LLM Gateway: LiteLLM or Portkey (centralised LLM routing, cost controls, audit logging), API key management

Collaboration & Productivity: Slack, Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Notion, GitHub (org-level administration)

Automation & Integration: Okta Workflows, Terraform, Python scripting

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Administer and engineer Okta as the central identity provider: SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning/de-provisioning, MFA policies, Okta Workflows for lifecycle automation (onboarding, offboarding, role changes)
- Own Google Workspace administration: domain management, email routing and security policies (DKIM/DMARC/SPF), shared drives governance, DLP rules and Google Vault for eDiscovery/retention
- Deploy and operate a centralised LLM gateway (e.g. LiteLLM, Portkey) to give teams governed access to AI models with usage tracking, cost controls, rate limiting and audit logging
- Manage endpoint fleets via Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS): OS patching, app deployment, compliance baselines, disk encryption enforcement
- Operate and improve compliance automation tooling (Vanta/Drata) to maintain continuous SOC 2, ISO 27001 and similar audit readiness
- Administer SaaS platforms at the org level: Slack (Enterprise Grid), Atlassian suite, Notion, GitHub (org/team/repo policies, SAML)
- Maintain documentation, runbooks and internal knowledge-base articles so that common procedures are self-service where possible
- Participate in on-call rotation for identity, email and critical SaaS platform incidents

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 3–7 years of professional experience in IT engineering, internal platform engineering or infrastructure with a strong focus on enterprise SaaS and identity systems
- Deep hands-on experience with Okta including SSO, SCIM provisioning and MFA policy management
- Strong Google Workspace administration skills (domain management, email security, DLP, Vault)
- Experience managing macOS fleets at scale using Jamf
- Comfortable writing automation scripts (Go/Python) and working with APIs to integrate SaaS tools
- Ability to translate security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001) into practical engineering controls
- Strong written communication for documentation, runbooks and cross-team collaboration in a remote-first environment
- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus — at HTB, this isn't an afterthought, it's the business

Bonus Points:

- Experience deploying and operating a centralised LLM/AI gateway (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) with cost and access controls
- Familiarity with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe)
- Understanding of Go/Python for building internal tooling
- Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator certification, or equivalent
- Experience scaling internal platforms through a period of rapid company growth (100 → 500+ employees)

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior IT Platform Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior IT Platform Engineer:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

postings.title: Senior Network Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Network engineer:

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will own the design, deployment and day-to-day reliability of the network fabric that connects Hack The Box's data center footprint across the US, EU, Singapore and Australia. Your work directly underpins the platform experience for millions of users running live cyber simulations — low-latency, high-availability networking isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product.

Design and operate production-grade, multi-site network architectures using BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and JunOS, ensuring our data center interconnects are resilient, observable and ready to scale as HTB grows into new regions.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the wider infrastructure team, reporting to the Director of Infrastructure. You will work alongside systems engineers, platform engineers and SREs responsible for bare-metal, virtualization and container platforms. You will also work cross functionally with security operations, product engineering and IT operations

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, JunOS (Juniper QFX/MX), OSPF, Spine-Leaf / IP Fabric, VLANs, VRFs, Linux networking, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus / Grafana, Observability tooling

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Design and implement spine-leaf network architectures across multiple data center sites in the US, EU, Singapore and Australia
- Operate and troubleshoot BGP (eBGP/iBGP) peering, route policies and prefix filtering in a multi-site environment
- Build and maintain EVPN-VXLAN overlay fabrics for scalable Layer 2/Layer 3 connectivity across data centers
- Configure, upgrade and harden Juniper network equipment (QFX, MX series) running JunOS
- Develop and maintain network automation using Ansible, Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling
- Establish and improve network monitoring, alerting and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, streaming telemetry)
- Plan and execute network capacity upgrades, site bring-ups and hardware refresh cycles
- Collaborate with the platform/systems engineering team on network requirements for VMware, Kubernetes and Ceph storage clusters
- Document network designs, runbooks and standard operating procedures for a globally distributed team
- Participate in on-call rotation for network-related incidents across all regions

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 5+ years of professional experience in network engineering, with a focus on data center networking

postings.title: Senior Network Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Network engineer:

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will own the design, deployment and day-to-day reliability of the network fabric that connects Hack The Box's data center footprint across the US, EU, Singapore and Australia. Your work directly underpins the platform experience for millions of users running live cyber simulations — low-latency, high-availability networking isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product.

Design and operate production-grade, multi-site network architectures using BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and JunOS, ensuring our data center interconnects are resilient, observable and ready to scale as HTB grows into new regions.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the wider infrastructure team, reporting to the Director of Infrastructure. You will work alongside systems engineers, platform engineers and SREs responsible for bare-metal, virtualization and container platforms. You will also work cross functionally with security operations, product engineering and IT operations

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, JunOS (Juniper QFX/MX), OSPF, Spine-Leaf / IP Fabric, VLANs, VRFs, Linux networking, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus / Grafana, Observability tooling

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Design and implement spine-leaf network architectures across multiple data center sites in the US, EU, Singapore and Australia
- Operate and troubleshoot BGP (eBGP/iBGP) peering, route policies and prefix filtering in a multi-site environment
- Build and maintain EVPN-VXLAN overlay fabrics for scalable Layer 2/Layer 3 connectivity across data centers
- Configure, upgrade and harden Juniper network equipment (QFX, MX series) running JunOS
- Develop and maintain network automation using Ansible, Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling
- Establish and improve network monitoring, alerting and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, streaming telemetry)
- Plan and execute network capacity upgrades, site bring-ups and hardware refresh cycles
- Collaborate with the platform/systems engineering team on network requirements for VMware, Kubernetes and Ceph storage clusters
- Document network designs, runbooks and standard operating procedures for a globally distributed team
- Participate in on-call rotation for network-related incidents across all regions

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 5+ years of professional experience in network engineering, with a focus on data center networking
- Deep hands-on experience with BGP (eBGP/iBGP), including route policies, communities and prefix management across multi-site environments
- Proven experience designing and operating EVPN-VXLAN fabrics
- Strong proficiency with JunOS and Juniper switching/routing platforms (QFX, MX series)
- Solid understanding of spine-leaf / IP fabric architectures, VLANs, VRFs and inter-VLAN routing
- Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Nornir or similar)
- Comfortable with Linux networking fundamentals (iptables/nftables, routing, bonding, VXLANs at the host level)
- Strong troubleshooting skills — ability to methodically diagnose complex, multi-layer issues under pressure
- Excellent written communication for documenting designs and collaborating in a remote-first environment
- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus

Bonus Points:

- Experience with network operations in a multi-region, multi-continent data center environment
- Familiarity with Ceph or other distributed storage systems from a network-performance perspective (NVMEoF, RDMA, high-throughput east-west traffic)
- Exposure to Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, service meshes, load balancers)
- JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP or equivalent networking certifications
- Understanding of Golang for building internal network tooling or automation
- Experience in a cybersecurity-focused or platform-as-a-service company

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Network Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior Network Engineer:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

The Core Mission of the Sr Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager within the Enterprise Product team, your mission is to define and deliver products that help enterprise customers adopt, manage, and scale Hack The Box across their organisations. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to solve complex customer problems, drive product strategy, and deliver measurable business impact. Success in this role means balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and commercial priorities to build enterprise-grade experiences that accelerate growth and strengthen customer retention.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe (EoR - Employee of Record through Deel) OR Athens, Greece (we'll support your relocation)
- If in Athens, Greece: Hybrid (2 days in office)
- Full time

✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

📚 Interesting resources you should check:

- Meet the humans behind the screens
- Pavlos’ journey into product management

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Sr Product Manager:

- Product Ownership: Lead the discovery and delivery of data-centric features, ensuring high adoption of reporting tools.
- Outcome-Oriented Roadmap: Define and implement a roadmap backed by KPIs, focusing on data accuracy and user engagement with insights.
- Data Collaboration: Work daily with Analytics and Data Engineering teams; you should be comfortable reading raw data and translating it into a product vision.
- Cross-functional Follow-through: Partner with Engineering and Design for implementation, then align with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure users understand the value of our insights.
- Customer Research: Conduct deep-dive sessions with B2B customers to quantify their data needs and translate them into feature requirements.
- Autonomy: Take full ownership of the product area, setting independent goals and priorities that align with the broader company vision.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Sr Product Manager:

- Experience: 3-5 years of Product Management experience with a B2B SaaS Product, dealing with enterprise customers, Product Marketing, etc.
- Technical Data Skills: Hands-on experience with analytics tools like Tableau, Metabase, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
- Agile Mastery: Strong knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies and experience working closely with engineering teams.
- Communication: Superior ability to articulate data plans to non-technical stakeholders and translate complex "data-speak" into meaningful features.
- The ability to demonstrate knowledge of converting data to insights (be prepared to share a specific story on this).
- AI Proficiency: Experience using AI for prompting, prototyping, and research; understanding of fine-tuning and human-evaluation on top of AI models.
- Adaptability: Agility in your way of working, with the ability to pivot based on data-driven insights.

Nice to Haves

- Experience in data-heavy industries (LMS, Reporting, or Logging).
- Technical background: Ability to follow architectural discussions regarding data pipelines.
- Cybersecurity knowledge: Specifically understanding nuances like Framework coverage (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK).

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰We also have other benefits that will keep you happy - Applicable for Athens, Greece:

- Private health care
- Paid parental leave (4 weeks)
- 25 annual leave days
- Free lunch & snacks at the office
- 120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
- Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident
- Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
- Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Sr Product Manager at HTB:

- Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
- Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions.
- Level 3 — Chat with Mike: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
- Level 4 — Practical Task and Panel Presentation: A real-world scenario that lets you show how you’d approach product management with your unique perspective. You’ll present your work to a panel of the team — no trick questions, no gotchas, just a chance to show us how you think and tell a story.
- Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership (CPO) to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 6 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

postings.title: Site Reliability Engineer
postings.description:
Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳
Let's redefine cyber security expertise standards and connect business - community through highly engaging hacking experiences. (Find out more insights about Hack The Box culture in our career site).

✨ The Core Mission of the Site Reliability Engineer (SRE):

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Hack The Box, your paramount mission is to empower our Content Engineering team by providing reliable, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure for our hands-on learning experiences.

Over the next 6 months, you will participate in enhancing and simplifying the systems, services, and tools that enable Content Engineers to build and operate cloud labs efficiently. You will focus on infrastructure automation, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of the workflows that support content creation and delivery.

In parallel, you will contribute to the broader Site Reliability Engineering practice by helping maintain production services, improving platform reliability, supporting observability initiatives, and collaborating with fellow SREs on operational excellence efforts. While your primary focus will be the Content Engineering domain, you will remain closely aligned with the team’s reliability, automation, and infrastructure standards.

⚔️ Technology Tools & Weapons You’ll Be Using:

- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform): Automate the provisioning and management of cloud resources.
- Cloud Platforms (Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, AWS): Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure powering our cloud labs.
- Observability & Monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo): Maintain visibility into platform health and reliability.
- CI/CD & Automation: Improve and automate existing workflows and deployment processes.
- Collaboration & Enablement: Work closely with Content Engineers to improve developer experience and platform adoption.

🚀 The Adventures That Await Your Life Becoming a Site Reliability Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Heavily contribute to the reliability and scalability of the infrastructure powering Hack The Box cloud labs.
- Partner with Content Engineers to improve workflows, remove operational friction, and enable faster content delivery.
- Train and facilitate engineers on infrastructure best practices, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native technologies.
- Design, implement, and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure across multiple cloud providers.
- Build and enhance observability capabilities that improve operational visibility and incident response.
- Support production environments through maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Collaborate with the broader SRE team, contributing to shared platform reliability efforts when needed.
- Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve consistency across systems and processes.

🏆 Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Points Required to Unlock the Role of SRE at Hack The Box:

- Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
- Experience operating and supporting workloads in Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

postings.title: Solutions Engineer
postings.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help redefine cybersecurity expertise. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Solutions Engineer:

Embark on a quest to revolutionize Hack The Box’s presence in the cybersecurity landscape. Your mission is to provide technical, story-based consultations and deliverables while becoming a subject matter expert (SME) on all things Hack The Box. Within 4 months, you'll focus on mastering our products and services, delivering top-notch demos, and supporting our enterprise clients in their cybersecurity journey. In the next year, your role will expand to include professional trainings and workshops, contributing to our ongoing growth and success.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Full-time employment
- 3 options (order of preference)

- UK preferred (fully remote)
- Athens, Greece (hybrid)
- Anywhere in Europe - through an EoR employment

✈️ Relocation

We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your relocation to Athens, Greece

In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.

We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Join a band of talented SE’s with diverse expertise in consulting, penetration testing, incident response, and security operation centers. You'll report to the Senior Director, Global Solutions Engineering, and collaborate extensively with various departments, including Content Development, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Infrastructure, and Analytics. Your role is crucial in bridging technical knowledge and practical application to help our clients realize exceptional results and value from our offerings.

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Project tracking tools
- Ticketing systems
- CRMs
- Linux & Windows virtual machines
- Macs
- A wide array of tools for offensive and defensive cyber operations
- Hack The Box Systems & Services

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming a Solutions Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Plan and deliver tailored and impactful product demos to new prospects and existing clients.
- Collaborate with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers on deal strategy and paths to a “technical win”.
- Plan and guide customers through value-led trials and evaluations of Hack The Box’s offerings
- Build and maintain relationships with customer technical stakeholders to ensure we continuously meet
- Conduct Hack The Box workshops and professional trainings.
- Dive deep into our HTB content to become a strong SME.
- Provide technical story-based consultations and deliverables to clients.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Solutions Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role as a Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or similar in the Cybersecurity space.
- Strong understanding of SaaS models and cybersecurity concepts.
- Relentless curiosity and hunger for learning.
- Natural ability to converse and build rapport with everyone from practitioners to executives.
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Strong assets include:

- Past experience working with Channel Partners in the EMEA region.
- Past work experience in Technical Consulting, Penetration Testing, Red Teaming, DFIR, or a combination of these fields is a strong asset.
- Relevant certifications in cybersecurity (e.g., CJCA, CDSA, CPTS, CEH, OSCP, CISSP)
- Prior experience with the Hack The Box platform

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰The gems you’ll be enjoying as a Solutions Engineer :

- Private Health Care & Life Insurance
- Home Office Allowance
- Ticket Restaurant Allowance
- Paid paternity leave
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Fully remote is an option. But we do have an office in London & Folkestone, UK

- Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
- Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions.
- Level 3 — Chat with Kevin: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.

- Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.

postings.title: Tech Customer Support
postings.description:
Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳
Let's redefine cyber security expertise standards and connect business - community through highly engaging hacking experiences. (Find out more insights about Hack The Box culture in our career site).

✨The core mission of the Tech Customer Support:

The Customer Support department consists of an international team, covering different time zones on a 24-hour basis. Main objective is to provide support to incoming requests from HTB users & customers across all products. Customer Support Agents collaborate closely with other departments (e.g. infra, content development & software engineering) so that they can provide solutions and resolve issues. Customer satisfaction and speed of resolving issues are the main metrics in the Tech Customer Support team. Also, occasional weekend shift coverage may be required a few times per year.

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

Main responsibilities will be the troubleshooting and the provision of innovative approaches to resolving incidents, covering the weekend shift. Being already part of the HTB community is an asset in this role, since there is a need for support across our HTB platforms. We are mainly using Intercom with our type of communication being mostly written, so a good knowledge of English language and good writing skills are a must have. Your experience in web development as well will be highly appreciated.

Based on the needs of the team, please take into consideration that we are looking to cover the South East Asia time zone (UTC +08:00)

⚔️ Technology tools & weapons you’ll be using:

- Intercom, Jira, HTB Platforms

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Tech Customer Support at Hack The Box:

- Manage requests from the customer user-base, across our HTB platforms and be able to reproduce user-reported issues
- Forward requests to relevant parties internally for solution provisioning or additional checks
- Communicate in real-time with users via Intercom and in exceptional cases through Discord
- Update relevant stakeholders on a daily basis on the progress of technically complex issues
- Open internal JIRA tickets for relevant teams, including reproducible steps, based on the platform and the nature of the issue (bug or user issue)
- Evaluate the impact of issues, either in frontend or backend, and take appropriate actions
- Maintain a high level of familiarity with our platform.

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Tech Customer Support at Hack The Box:

- Already acquainted with the platforms and products on offer from Hack The Box
- Proficiency with developer tools (DevTools)
- Good knowledge of Windows & Linux operating systems
- Previous experience in web applications development, providing familiarity with common issues faced in this domain
- Ability to identify bugs & clearly describe the issue
- Experience in scripting languages, such as Powershell, Bash, Python is a significant advantage.
- Proficiency in English language (verbal & written)
- Strong troubleshooting skills and patience
- Some experience with networks and network engineering
- Ability to organize and manage multiple communication channels and issues, working both independently and remotely
- Strong communication skills for direct interaction with users via chat

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Tech Customer Support:

- 25 annual leave days
- Paid parental leave
- Home Office Allowance
- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
- State-of-the-art equipment
- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
- Flexibility in working hours

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Tech Customer Support:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: connect with the hiring team, share with them your achievements and participate in a job related assignment
- Level 4: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
- Level 5: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

ABOUT HACK THE BOX

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Trusted by the Fortune 500, government agencies, and MSSPs, the platform delivers threat-informed learning paths consisting of real-world scenarios in gamified labs and live-fire simulations that build and validate offensive and defensive cyber capabilities. With a loyal community of more than 4 million members and 800+ enterprise customers, Hack The Box empowers teams and intelligent systems alike to strengthen cyber defenses and reduce breach risk effectively.

Rapidly growing its international footprint and reach, Hack The Box is headquartered in the UK, with additional offices in the US, Australia, and Greece.
